71:     def makeValidateLink(self, valSession, clientSecret, nextLink):
72:         base = self.sydent.cfg.get('http', 'client_http_base')
73:         link = "%s/_matrix/identity/api/v1/validate/email/submitToken?token=%s&client_secret=%s&sid=%d" % (
74:             base,
75:             urllib.quote(valSession.token),
76:             urllib.quote(clientSecret),
77:             valSession.id,
78:         )
79:         if nextLink:
80:             # manipulate the nextLink to add the sid, because
81:             # the caller won't get it until we send a response,
82:             # by which time we've sent the mail.
83:             if '?' in nextLink:
84:                 nextLink += '&'
85:             else:
86:                 nextLink += '?'
87:             nextLink += "sid=" + urllib.quote(str(valSession.id))
88: 
89:             link += "&nextLink=%s" % (urllib.quote(nextLink))
90:         return link

92:     def validateSessionWithToken(self, sid, clientSecret, token):
93:         valSessionStore = ThreePidValSessionStore(self.sydent)
94:         s = valSessionStore.getTokenSessionById(sid)
95:         if not s:
96:             logger.info("Session ID %s not found", (sid))
97:             return False
98: 
99:         if not clientSecret == s.clientSecret:

102: 
103:         if s.mtime + ValidationSession.THREEPID_SESSION_VALIDATION_TIMEOUT < time_msec():
104:             logger.info("Session expired")
105:             raise SessionExpiredException()
106: 
107:         # TODO once we can validate the token oob

113:             valSessionStore.setValidated(s.id, True)
114: 
115:             return {'success': True}
116:         else:
117:             logger.info("Incorrect token submitted")
